FROMLIST: mm/failslab: By default, do not fail allocations with direct reclaim only When failslab was originally written, the intention of the "ignore-gfp-wait" flag default value ("N") was to fail GFP_ATOMIC allocations. Those were defined as (__GFP_HIGH), and the code would test for __GFP_WAIT (0x10u). However, since then, __GFP_WAIT was replaced by __GFP_RECLAIM (___GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM|___GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM), and GFP_ATOMIC is now defined as (__GFP_HIGH|__GFP_ATOMIC|__GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM). This means that when the flag is false, almost no allocation ever fails (as even GFP_ATOMIC allocations contain ___GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM). Restore the original intent of the code, by ignoring calls that directly reclaim only (__GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM), and thus, failing GFP_ATOMIC calls again by default. Fixes: 71baba4b92dc1fa1 ("mm, page_alloc: rename __GFP_WAIT to __GFP_RECLAIM") Signed-off-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Akinobu Mita <akinobu.mita@gmail.com> Acked-by: David Rientjes <rientjes@google.com> (am from https://lore.kernel.org/patchwork/patch/1076629/) (also found at https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20190520214514.81360-1-drinkcat@chromium.org) BUG=chromium:964234 TEST=Boot with FAILSLAB, set /sys/kernel/debug/failslab/probability to 10, see that some allocations are failed. Change-Id: Ie745a35f19d82ab8cd1e3fc005aa2210ca344cd9 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1617172 Commit-Ready: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org>

oobe_config: Make oobe state files accessible in oobe_config_save. As oobe_config_save is running in a minijail, it doesn't have access to "/home/chronos/.oobe_completed" and "/home/chronos/Consent To Send Stats" files, that it needs to check for existence. Instead of binding the whole /home/chronos directory in the minijail, it's possible to copy the files to /var/lib/oobe_config_save/ directory that is already accessible for oobe_config_save. Another option might be to bind mount only these files, but then minijail init will fail if they don't exist. BUG=chromium:961294 TEST=Manual, new unit tests. Change-Id: I6e2f7e96de1fe8982ede1672959c0ed98f6ee342 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1617405 Commit-Ready: Sergey Poromov <poromov@chromium.org> Tested-by: Sergey Poromov <poromov@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zentaro Kavanagh <zentaro@chromium.org>
